notes.title: Free to Play Transition Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone

As mentioned in our previous post, the game's transition to the free-to-play model will be completed soon.

This patch will include some bug fixes and improvements for the major 0.5.2 version

Fixes:

1- Fixed wolves constantly chasing players.
2- Fixed an issue where items from zombies usually spawn ammo.
3- Fixed shadow performance issues.
4- Fixed some objects and buildings popping up while moving through the map.
5- Fixed farming always needs a light issue.
6- After the plants are planted, you don't need to plant a new one, if you harvest the plant after its growth has passed, the plant starts to grow again.
7- The bed with a respawn point in the swamp section allowed the character to get stuck with very little possibility, this has been fixed
8- Fixed too many rainy day cycles and reduced their probability
9- Some animals on the map got stuck on rocks, this has been fixed
10- Fixed all objects on the map that appear to be detached from the ground
11- Fixed some visual bugs

Added:

1- A new NPC, Trader. With this NPC you can sell your resources and can reach faster than hard-to-reach things in the game. (He is located at Swamp Area)
2- A new item has been added to the game, Coin. Which is the current currency of the game.
3- New materials were added to the chest at the start of the mission.
4- Water Resources have been added to certain parts of the map once more, now you can locate them by looking at your map.
5- Map icon showing where the Military Barrack is located.

also added 

Exclusively for players who have already purchased the game 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791715/eaf108147c52ab0e4ffd7420a1822a9806049be4.png

Two character skins and Three equipment skins will be gifted to players who already bought the game. This will happen ASAP after the free-to-play transition has been done.

(A small note, there is a very long time difference between us and Steam, so there may be delays in the introduction of exclusive content to players. Shortly after Steam notifies us of the free-to-play transition, this content will be automatically released to players who have already purchased the game.) 

Character skins can be found by scrolling through the character selection section on the lobby screen.

Other equipment skins can be used forever by purchasing only 1 coin from the trader in the game and their stocks are entered in a way that rarely decreases.

(A small note, weapon skins and normal weapons in the game have the same function, but they are not the same type of items. So, for example, if you want to use your skinned M4 weapon, you have to use a skinned magazine.)

We would like to thank everyone who has approached us sincerely and provided positive and negative feedback so far.

Discord and Mail Support will be ended also after the free-to-play transition has been done.

notes.title: Major Patch 0.5.2 Available NOW!
notes.content:
Hello! The 5.2 patch has been released.

Major Patch Features

Map Expand

Map expansion with new areas. The new map is four times larger than the previous one.

Swimming System

Introducing a swimming system for players who want to explore the sea. More updates for underwater events and lootable items are planned.

Climbing System

Added the option to climb stairs, setting the foundation for future use.

Special Note Slot

Created a special slot for notes relevant to the story, allowing players to access them at any time.

Inventory Management

Quality of life updates based on player feedback, including auto-stack for split items, the ability to take all items in a chest, and store all items in the chest.

Fully Customizable Map System

Users can place their markers on the map, making it customizable and user-friendly.

New Design for Interaction UI


Redesigned the interaction UI for a more modern and keyboard-friendly experience.

Item Updates

Updated the shapes, areas, and definitions of around 200 items for better gameplay.

New Mission System

Added the basics of a mission system to help players progress. Feedback is appreciated for further improvement.

Expand Lore and Story

Deepened the background lore and story, providing more information about the game and its world through future updates.

Minor Improvements

Numerous minor performance improvements, new rendering techniques, and other system updates.
With this update, we've added many fixes and improvements. However, we'd like to share some known issues with you.

Known Issues

In multiplayer sessions, players might trigger 'location objectives' remaining from completed missions, potentially causing early location objective triggers.

In the HUD, a crafting process timer has been added, but there's a chance it might stick at full progression. It should disappear once the crafting is done.

Some AI units may be unresponsive.

Players joining multiplayer lobbies might occasionally experience being stuck. If this occurs, you can reset your character using the "K" key.

We are aware of these issues and are actively working to resolve them. If you come across any additional bugs, please report them to us on Steam or Discord. 


Thank you and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Major Patch 0.5.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791715/318f4c4d5d2dcb4b71c5b710cc27993b6442adc8.png

at the end of a very long and tired period as indie developers of our size, we are here with the new patch with our shortcomings and excesses

This patch includes a lot of Quality of Life and the basics of newly added features, so let's take a quick look at what we've added

For a summary, you can watch all the features on the youtube link below

[previewyoutube=296eqWg91Go;full][/previewyoutube]


IMPORTANT 

Localization for other Languages

We translated our game into 7 different languages other than English, in order 


 German 
 Spanish 
 Portuguese 
 Russian 
 Turkish 
 Ukrainian 
 Chinese


Note: We may be missing in this section, we will open a thread about this in the forums here and on our Discord server, we would be very happy if our followers who can help us send us feedback about these areas.




Major Patch Features

1- Map Expand 

Map Expansion with new areas. The game's new map is 4 times larger than the previous map

2- Swiming System

We brought new mechanics to the game, for example, the swimming system for players who want to use the sea (This System will receive more updates, there will be events that we can do under the water or items that we can loot)

3- Climbing System

Apart from this, the option of climbing the stairs, which is very much demanded, has been added, although it is not much use at the moment, we wanted to lay the foundation now because you will use it a lot in the future.

4- Special Note Slot

We know you don't want to carry notes on your person, so we've created a special slot for this part and turned all the notes that are relevant to the story and that you want to go back and read into something that you can access at any time once you've interacted with that note

5- Inventory Management

There are nice quality of life updates that we have made by evaluating every feedback you have sent to our forums and discord server here, for example, the auto stack feature for your previously split items, or the feature of taking all the items in a chest you find, or the feature of storing all the items on you in that chest.

6- Fully Customizable Map System

In this system, it was something that many of our users wanted to be in our game, you can put your own markers in many places on the map opened by pressing the M key, except for the previously placed markers, and you can see where you are.

7- New design for Interaction UI

We are aware that the previous interaction design we used is a bit old-fashioned, we are aware that constantly interacting with the mouse and assigning all the interactions to a key was damaging the feeling that I was interacting with something in the game in our eyes, so we are designing this part from scratch and coming up with a design to use your keyboard more

8- We made updates to many items

We have changed the shapes of many previously added items (about 200 items) and the items we added later, the areas they occupy and their definitions

9- New Mission System

We have added the basics of our mission system to the game to help you progress in the game, this part still needs polishing, but we have the idea to bring it to a much higher level with the feedback we will receive from you.

10- Expand Lore and Story

We have deepened the background lore and story of the game a bit more and as we send updates you will have much more information about the game and its world.


11-Minor ImprovementsMany minor performance improvements, new rendering techniques in visual quality and other system updates, we do best we can



Developer Message

There are dozens of innovations that we planned to release this update but could not bring, and each new development brings with it much greater responsibilities. So if you want to support the game, now is the time to do so, because we will decide whether or not to continue with the game based on the feedback from this update. For indie teams like ours, the continuity and motivation of their work takes a very big place, and if we get enough support, we have a goal to bring the whole road map without a doubt.

Endless thanks to everyone who has already sent us supportive feedback. 

See you in the middle of nowhere

Wishing everyone a happy and beautiful New Year

notes.title: About Next Major Patch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791715/318f4c4d5d2dcb4b71c5b710cc27993b6442adc8.png

Hello Everyone

As you know, we have been working on the major patch for a long time, it is very difficult and tiring for teams of our size to bring such updates, but we are trying to bring them to you as quickly and accurately as we can.

Below are the exact things that are in the upcoming update


[olist]
 We deleted the city part on the TIER 1 map and turned it into a village that is more in touch with nature. Since this place does not fit the ambiance of the place, we organized this place and made it more suitable for our lore.

 Significant updates have been made on the optimization side of the game, with which you will be able to see the diversity in nature and the resources you interact with more frequently, without distorting the visuals

 In this patch, we have introduced the new Trade system with the NPC you will encounter in the game (In Tier 1 we think the number of this is one, but as the map grows, you will encounter dozens of traders due to both resources and the nature of the game)

 Fully Customizable new map system new point of interest locations

 We have made serious accessibility and quality-of-life improvements on the User Interface side. We have added many new functions to the inventory management system such as reordering your items, taking all the items from another container or putting them back there, and automatic stacking. 

 We have added a new interaction User Interface, now instead of using a mouse roll, we have made them much simpler and kept the keyboard interaction a little high, such as picking up with press E and hold E for equip, and also without taking an item, for example if it is a weapon.
 
 We've introduced new Items, most of which are now on the resource side, such as new consumable items and crafting materials.

 We will introduce a new mission system with a clear outline, which we think is ideal for guiding you and ideal for capturing story sequences. this is a part that will develop as the game develops. let's keep this place hidden for now to avoid further spoilers

 We have designed a special section for the main menu and Documents, for example, with this, you will not have to carry the notes you read in the game on you, we have designed a section where you can access the notes whenever you want.

 We are adding the Dismantle and Scavenge Mechanic to the game, you don't have to pick up an axe you see on the ground, you can now dismantle it for this. Also when you come across a pile of metal while traveling through the game, you can scavenge it and find valuable materials for you. 

 We have completely overhauled Stone and Metal Structures and changed their appearance, in addition to this, we aimed to add a little more depth to your structures in the game by adding new columns and windows, I hope you like it.
 
 We add new decor, such as tables, chairs, and cabinets. The cabinets will also be able to store things in them. 

 We've added a naming option to your existing crafted chests.

 We have simplified the farming part a bit, taking it away from the simulation side and making it a bit more player-friendly

 Revolver, AK-47, Shotgun, and bow and arrow weapons.

 We will bring new parts to the weapons, such as a laser pointer and a silencer, one of which will increase your weapon's recoil, while the other will lower it, allowing you to take down enemies more silently.

 We are adding two new enemy types that we don't want to show for now because they are still WIP

 The swimming system and the underwater system that will come with it, we still need time for this because we need time to design not only the surface but also the underwater surfaces.
[/olist]

As soon as the new patch is released, we will open our public road map Trello page to users, from here you will be able to follow what will come for which patch on what we are working on.

Localization will come on this patch too: Our first priorty adding Chinese,Russian,Ukranian,Portuguese,Spanish on this patch

Also a note: contrary to popular belief, we have not abandoned or quit the game, I think everyone has a misconception about this because the development team is exactly 3 people and all of these large-scale updates are time-consuming. We are updating more often on our Discord server and we take the time to observe or answer your valuable feedback as much as we can.

notes.title: Early Access Road Map
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42791715/17262c155514bb3bd811f6fb2233c1a1b57e7d2b.png

Hello everyone. Our roadmap after the curious early access is explained in detail below. 

Apart from that, first of all, how much we thank our players who give us feedback and share the shortcomings of the game with us, you are the real heroes of this game and we will never forget the value of this.


Let's start in order then

Early Access Start

As you all know, this is the point where we brought the game with zero investment with a team of our number after about 1 year of development adventure.

What's here?

The basic survival mechanics that we want to have in our game are familiar from many games and this part, which we will continue to develop, is a component of our game, not an actual part of our game. we want to develop our game more on the adventure side, more riddles, more mysteries to be solved. and while doing all of this, you also have to survive at the same time, I will touch on the details a little more in the other paragraphs.  


He Was A Good Stalker

This is where we will drop our first major patch, although the order of the innovations it contains is mixed.

We will start the basic mission system of our game here, so we will lay the foundations here. What does that mean? We have already anticipated what our players demand from us, and that is this. What is the purpose of playing this game? We were aware that there were questions like what we came here to do, but we didn't want to touch on these places without making our basic systems work correctly because this place will actually affect the story and other systems in the game, so we decided to build this part after our basic mechanics and collect other structures on it.

''He was a good stalker'' update will also include

Swimming System and Ocean Biome

Underground Catacombs: a few of these we reach from the bottom of the ground by swimming

Trader System: We will have merchants that appear in certain areas of the game and can change locations every day, from which you will learn new recipes and new information


New Full Map System: This is more expandable and useful than the right now system. you can create your own mark for loots and customize their name

Also mini useful tutorial hints for crafting and gathering resources


Survival Instinct

In this part, we want to increase the survival instincts of our players a little more. What does that mean, not enough?

No, there isn't.

One of the systems we are planning to add here is the relationship between heat and cold. There will even be a system that separates the points where daylight hits from the shadow, so you can get warmer in daylight, while you will get colder if you are in a cave or a place that does not receive daylight. 

Then, another innovation we want to bring to this major patch is the electricity system. You will be able to use your own electricity system in the game and open more advanced structures and discover new items.

New blueprints will be available to learn from merchants and many of these will be for building elements.

If we can, we plan to bring a new character system and changeable outfits right here, but if not, we aim to spread it out over time. 

In this second part, we also want to design a completely new lobby system for our multiplayer players, a hub of your own and we want to make a fun environment where you can choose where to go from there.


You Are Not Alone

Are you the only one looking for artifacts in the Nowhere world?

In our 3rd major update, we plan to bring new factions and enemy types to the game, some of them will be natural against you, some of them will be aggressive and some of them will be aggressive on both sides. some of them are looking for artifacts in the world just like you, some of them are just protecting their towns and don't welcome outsiders.

With this 3rd major update, the game's map will be greatly expanded, players will now have tier I tier II transitions, and we will also be building islands that can be accessed from the ocean parts of the game, a few of which will contain treasures and their own stories.

at the same time, the content of the game will continue to evolve, we will have much more information about the root experiment and a lot of POIs will also be included in the game


Nuclear Power

As soon as the 3rd major update is over, we will be able to open access to much larger craft options with the tier 2 part we added to the game, but this will not be for free, of course, for this you will have to enter high-risk areas and fight with abnormal types, let's not give spoilers for this place for now =)


Radiation STORMS!

We are very excited about this part, please don't interpret it as if it will be like the horde system in other games, what we are thinking about in this content is much more exciting and we think like an event with more lively motives to keep you in the game

There will be radiation storms that will start all over the map at certain times of the game. When these storms start, if your structure is not solid, you will have to consolidate before it starts, if not, you will have to suffer the consequences, because of this event that will take place on the map, you will sometimes start to see hallucinations, and with this update, we will also activate the mental health system that we are thinking of adding to the game.

Not only that but there will be new enemy elements that will threaten you during the storm. some of the underground shelters found in the game will also be added to the game with this and this places safe to hide from radiation storms too

As we approach this part, we are very, very excited to share more details with our players

Going Deep on Root Experiment

Now we are nearing the end of the Root Experiment, this will be the update where the map expands for the last time. This is the last Big update where we will now master all the basics and details of the story. it will happen right here

End Of The Early Access

Since we think that almost everything we want in our game works perfectly, then we plan to exit early access and switch to the full version game status, I must warn you in this section, the current price of our game will definitely increase. We would like to thank everyone who has completed this early access adventure with us so far


Artic Map Expansion And Polishes

How about going to the new places with all these updates and content that we have counted and digging to the root of a new story again?


Aside from the roadmap, We're going to do it with small patches between versions of the game, which includes many crafting options and item list updates. Like weapons and other stuff. We will also be constantly rolling out localization options for languages for which there is no firm date right now.

That's all for now. anyone who wants to discuss us via our road map and wants to send their ideas and feedback to us is welcome to our discord server.

Thank you very much for taking the time and reading all this stuff 

EFNSOFT - Emre

notes.title: Nowhere Demo Update 0.3.3 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hello Folks


Thank you very much for your interest in us and our game, I can't tell you how important it is for us. Endless thanks to everyone who played the demo, found our bugs and sent us feedback.

We are a small team and I can't describe how this is a source of motivation for us.

From now on, a more difficult and tiring process awaits us. We will soon share the Early Access Release date and the post-launch roadmap we have planned both here and on all our other social media addresses.

Due to the interest in the demo, instead of disabling the demo, we turned our demo version into a limited version. (Under normal circumstances, our game would only be open during Next Fest), however, we disabled the save and load system in our game only for the demo, and we added a 45-minute timer to our game.

See you again very soon in the Middle of Nowhere


Demo 0.3.3 Minor Update (Demo)

You can check below for the latest patch notes

[olist]

 Adding Timer to the game It will start automatically a countdown from beginning of the session

 Save Game and Load Game Disabled on Current Version (Only For Demo Version)

 Optimizing View Distance Settings

 Optimizing AI Spawn Rate 

 Tweaking Map and Optimization

 Adding Random Weather Variation to Game
[/olist]


Known Issues



 Some users getting Fatal errors if they are playing windowed or fullscreen mode begin of the session we are still investigating the issue and what can cause of this (If you want to help us send more log files with a crash report because we can't reproduce the same issue on our systems)

 There is no Invite option in the game menu
 
 Axe and Pickaxe Damage Hitboxes Not working stable (This will be fixed during EA)

 Hunger and Thirst Balance Not Stable  (This will be fixed during EA)

 Friends Only Option for Multiplayer is Buggy We will Completly Overhaul this system with password-protected server lobbies (This will be fixed during EA)



Ps. People who promt to menu while trying play co-op It is experiencing a network problem, the solution to this is unfortunately not on our side, like every other game, we use the Listen / Server Model, we could not repeat any of the errors that said they had this problem or reached us.

You can try the following to solve your problem

[olist]
 You can check whether the PC you are playing the game allows access to our game in the firewall settings

 You can check the port or DNS settings of the PC you are connected to the game (because steam sometimes does not let you into the game because of this and sends you back to the menu thinking that you are sending endless pings)

 If you are trying to play the game with a friend over LAN, this can cause the same problem
[/olist]

You can check the patch notes below

[olist]
 Adding Invert Horizontal/Vertical Mouse Settings

notes.title: Nowhere Demo Update 0.3.1 (Next Fest)
notes.content:
Hello 

Survivors here are latest patch notes for Demo Build


Demo 0.3.1 Minor Update (Next Fest)

1- A fix has been made for the Mouse sensitivity setting, which is the source of the pitch problem that users experience with the Mouse (It can be still buggy unless you are using your old control settings. You can manually adjust above 0 any value)

2- We have removed all recipes and craft items that are not currently in use

3- We have discovered that you can make placement on some Foliage, this problem has been fixed. (If this problem still persists on some objects, we would be grateful if you send us the screenshots)

4- Changed the names and descriptions of some objects, for example, Survival Benchmark is now Survival Bench

5- We have noticed that you cannot make Stone Furnace and Survival Bench on Landscape, we have achieved a more ideal result by reducing the offsets here. (If the error persists, it would be very good if you send us screenshots of the regions where you have this problem) 

6- The spawn time of Items in Objects has been extended 

7- AM/PM Text Deleted from UI

8- Minor Tweaks and Balance Options On Landscape Deformation

9- Player Name UI on the character now working correctly (if this issue still continues please let us know)

10- Nature Resource Like Stone and Tree Spawner Time Extended

11- Adding More Variety loot on Power Plant Area 

Ps. People who struggle with Furnaces, Campfire, and other elements we have that use fuel system

Basically not working if you are not Click on the Turn On/Off Button make sure also you have fuel item on your fuel storage
